thread:
mira: Heads-up — we're doing a regional KV-cache compaction in us-west this Sat 2026-04-11 02:00-03:30 UTC. Expect a short p99 bump for prefix-heavy routes (embeddings & long-context gen). We'll temporarily relax the embeddings-route SLO p99 from 150ms -> 220ms during the window. More details below.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance job created: <https://infra.jobs/2712345678|kv-compaction-usw1> :calendar:

sam: What's the rollback plan if we see >2% error or sustained p99 > 300ms? :question:

mira: Rollback = abort compaction job + rehydrate prefixes from warm cache snapshot. Runbook attached. If >2% errors, ops will stop and open an incident. We'll monitor controlplane and dataplane metrics.

jonah: Can we keep a warm subset untouched? Suggest keep 20% of pool on LRU-skip so client traffic hits warm caches.

mira: Yep — keeping 20% warm is the plan. We'll mark them with tag `kv:warm-skip` and exclude from compaction.

lorena: Oncall here — need runbook id and alert thresholds so I can update PagerDuty notes.

mira: Runbook: infra/runbooks/kv-compaction-v2. Snippet:
```
alert: kv_compaction_risk
conditions:
  - p99_latency > 300ms for 5m
  - errors_rate > 0.02 for 3m
action:
  - abort_job
  - rehydrate_from_snapshot
  - escalate_to_sre
```

priya: Any customer-facing comms planned? We have a few dedicated customers on embeddings route.

mira: We'll send a targeted notice to Dedicated accounts tonight, and add a banner in Console for everyone 1hr before. No public outage expected.

alex: Recommend a short synthetic load test 15m before compaction to prime caches and validate alarms. Command we use:
```
./tools/loadgen --route embeddings --qps 50 --duration 15m --tag precompaction-priming
```

mira: Good call — will run pre-priming at 01:30 UTC. Ops-bot will post results.

ops-bot: Pre-priming job scheduled: job/2712345789, will post results to #eng-sre.

sam: ack :thumbsup:
